question: is the media of the artery thinned under the most advanced plaque?
message: is the media of the artery thinned under the most advanced plaque?
reply:
Based on the provided histological image, **yes, the media of the artery is thinned under the most advanced part of the plaque.**

If you look at the pinkish, muscular layer (the tunica media) on the right side of the image, it has a certain thickness. As you follow it to the left, underneath the largest, most yellowish area of the atherosclerotic plaque, the pink media layer becomes visibly thinner and more compressed.

This is a common finding in advanced atherosclerosis, where the expanding plaque in the intima puts pressure on the underlying media, leading to atrophy and thinning of the muscular wall.
